audit.whatIsWrong: This is a 41.67% lane over 180 games — the second-worst in the slice — and the full layer presents it as a favoured one: green tone, diffRating 4/10, 'Favoured matchup — difficulty 4/10'. The chart gives Trundle 5 of 7 stages and Kayle none, even though whys[5] and whys[6] both describe her taking over from her first item.
audit.why: 41.67% is a losing lane no matter how strong the first three levels are. The prose is right about the shape (you own 1-3 and the level-6 window, she owns everything after her first item); the labels and the chart simply never caught up.
audit.corrected: Kayle given the first-item and two-item stages, tone moved to the hard colour, and 4/10 raised to 8/10 in diffRating, breakdown.difficulty and the final rating line. diff already said HARD and was left alone.
sources: the entry's own whys[5] and whys[6]

audit.whatIsWrong: The whole plan is 'bait her R', repeated in five fields, and Divine Judgment's cooldown appears nowhere.
audit.why: Divine Judgment is 160/120/80s. At rank 1 that is a 160-second hole — comfortably long enough to kill her twice — which is what makes spending a fake all-in to force it worth almost any price. Without the number the advice sounds like a platitude.
audit.corrected: Added 160s at rank 1 to mid, the cooldown block and the key-interactions line.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chomp is credited with an attack-speed steal in five fields (early, whys[0], whys[1], spikes[0], wants.you[0]) — against Kayle of all champions, whose entire identity is attack speed, so the error reads as a counter that does not exist. The content layer also never names a single Kayle ability.
audit.why: Chomp saps Attack Damage and briefly slows. Kayle's kit is Divine Ascent (P), Radiant Blast (Q), Celestial Blessing (W), Starfire Spellblade (E) and Divine Judgment (R), and none of those names appeared once.
audit.corrected: Every AS-steal claim replaced with the AD drain and the Chomp slow, and the real ability names worked into early, whys, spikes and late.

audit.whatIsWrong: Radiant Blast's resistance reduction is missing, and it is the direct counter to your ultimate.
audit.why: Riot text: 'Kayle conjures a portal, summoning a celestial sword that pierces through enemies, slowing, damaging, and reducing the resistances of all hit.' Subjugate's entire payoff is holding stolen Armor and MR — her Q shaves exactly that off you again. Nothing else in the matchup undoes your ultimate this directly.
audit.corrected: Named in late, phases[6].why and the cooldown block.

audit.whatIsWrong: Celestial Blessing is never mentioned, so there is no anti-heal timing and no account of how she escapes your level 1-3 pressure.
audit.why: Celestial Blessing is a flat 15-second heal plus move speed on herself and her nearest ally. It is both the reason your 'she has no escape' bullying window is narrower than stated and the reason Grievous Wounds matters here. Frozen Domain amplifies healing for you too, so anti-heal cuts both ways.
audit.corrected: Named in early with its 15s cooldown and the instruction to open after she spends it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Starfire Spellblade is absent, so the entry gives no burst tell and no reason her execute damage climbs as you drop.
audit.why: Starfire Spellblade is a 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s auto reset whose active deals bonus damage scaling with the target's missing health — so the lower you are, the harder each reset lands. Divine Ascent also grants attack range as she levels, which is what closes your bullying window rather than any single level.
audit.corrected: Divine Ascent's range gain added to wants.you[0]; Starfire Spellblade recorded here rather than forced into a field where it would displace something more useful.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are yours to take by force. Kayle is one of the weakest level-1s in the entire game — she auto-attacks like a minion and has no escape. Step onto her with Q Chomp immediately: the attack speed steal compounds with every subsequent hit and she cannot out-trade you in a sustained exchange. Drop Frozen Domain on top of her whenever she freezes the wave or looks to CS, and run her down inside it — your passive healing from minion deaths means her poke costs her more than it costs you. The goal by level 3 is either a kill or a meaningful CS lead; a Kayle who is 30 CS down at level 3 is buying herself one more level of hell before she can even think about scaling.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are yours to take by force. Kayle is one of the weakest level-1s in the entire game — no dash, no CC. Step onto her with Q Chomp immediately: it saps her attack damage and slows her, and she cannot out-trade you in a sustained exchange. Drop Frozen Domain on top of her whenever she freezes the wave or steps up to CS, and run her down inside it — King's Tribute off minion deaths means her poke costs her more than it costs you. Watch Celestial Blessing (W) on its flat 15-second cooldown; it heals and speeds her away, so open after she spends it. The goal by level 3 is a kill or a meaningful CS lead; a Kayle 30 CS down at level 3 is already behind her own curve.

edits.before: Kayle at level 1 has no escape and no CC — walk onto her with Q Chomp, steal her AS, and let minion deaths heal you back; she loses every sustained trade.
edits.after: Kayle at level 1 has no dash and no CC — walk onto her with Q Chomp, sap her AD, and let minion deaths heal you back; she loses every sustained trade.

edits.before: Chomp's AS steal stacks across repeated hits and Frozen Domain speed means she cannot disengage — at level 2 you run her down before she can create safe kiting distance.
edits.after: Chomp's slow and Frozen Domain's speed mean she cannot disengage without Celestial Blessing — at level 2 you run her down before she creates safe kiting distance.

edits.before: Chomp's AS steal and Frozen Domain movement speed let you bully Kayle off CS before she can safely auto-trade back — she has no escape and minimal base stats.
edits.after: Chomp's AD drain and Frozen Domain movement speed let you bully Kayle off CS before she can safely auto-trade back — no dash, and minimal base stats.

edits.before: Land Chomp to stack the AS steal and force her off CS in the first three levels before her ranged form arrives
edits.after: Chomp the AD out of her and force her off CS in the first three levels, before Divine Ascent grants range

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are where the lane starts to stabilize against you, not because Kayle wins them, but because a smart Kayle simply refuses to interact — she hugs tower, stacks CS, and tolerates the poke while waiting for level 6. You can still punish greedy CS attempts with Pillar cutting off her path back to tower, but respect that your kills-for-free window is closing. At level 6 hit Subjugate immediately on any skirmish: you strip a chunk of her MR and it lands on you, and combined with Frozen Domain you hit harder and heal faster than she can recover from without burning R. Force the R cooldown with a fake all-in if you must — a Kayle who burns her invulnerability on a bait is a Kayle you kill on the next trade.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are where the lane stabilizes against you, not because Kayle wins them, but because a smart Kayle refuses to interact — she hugs tower, stacks CS, and eats the poke while waiting for level 6. You can still punish greedy CS attempts with Pillar cutting her path back to tower, but your free-kill window is closing. At level 6 hit Subjugate immediately in any skirmish: you strip a chunk of her MR onto yourself, and with Frozen Domain you hit harder and heal faster than she recovers without burning R. Divine Judgment is 160 seconds at rank 1, so forcing it with a fake all-in is worth nearly any price — a Kayle who spent it on a bait dies on the next wave.

edits.before: Once Kayle reaches level 11 and flaming wave form this lane belongs to her. Her ranged DPS walks outside Frozen Domain permanently, her R invulnerability straight-counters the Subjugate window you saved for her, and two items means she out-damages your healing faster than you can regenerate it. Your job is to be ahead enough that it does not matter — take tower before level 11 if possible, rotate to team fights where Subjugate shines against tankier enemies, and never let a late-game Kayle 1v1 you alone in the side lane. In 5v5 your resistance-drain ultimate is still a weapon; the problem is she is also a weapon there, and hers scales higher.
edits.after: Once Kayle reaches level 11 and flaming wave form this lane belongs to her. Her ranged DPS sits outside Frozen Domain permanently, Divine Judgment straight-counters the Subjugate window you saved for her, and Radiant Blast shreds the very resistances you drained off her. Two items and she out-damages your healing faster than you regenerate it. Be far enough ahead that none of it matters — take tower before 11, rotate to fights where Subjugate works on tankier enemies, and never 1v1 a late Kayle in the side lane. In 5v5 your resistance-drain ultimate is still a weapon; the problem is that she is a weapon there too, and hers scales higher.

edits.before: Trinity Force is the duel spike — Spellblade procs off every Chomp. Force Kayle to answer you in the side lane.
edits.after: Nashor's Tooth is her spike — sustained ranged DPS outpaces your healing. Force the side lane before it lands.

edits.before: With two items you out-duel Kayle whenever R is up. The only loss condition left is fighting with Subjugate down — track it like she tracks Divine Judgment (Invuln).
edits.after: With two items she kites you out of Frozen Domain and Radiant Blast shaves off the resists you stole. Do not duel her — Subjugate a tank and win the fight elsewhere.

edits.after: Overall difficulty: 8/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Divine Judgment (Invuln) and how disciplined your pattern is.

edits.after: Hard matchup — difficulty 8/10, Kayle carry threat 6/10.

edits.after: - Kayle Divine Judgment (Invuln): matchup-defining — 160s at rank 1. Bait it and she dies next wave. - Kayle Radiant Blast: her Q pierces, slows, and reduces the resistances you just drained off her.

notes: Disk 41.67% / 180; packet says 49.23% / 130. The disk figure is the one the corrections are built on. I deliberately did not touch the 'level 11 flaming wave form' phrasing — Riot's Divine Ascent text says only that she gains attack speed, move speed, attack range and flame waves progressively as she levels and spends points, with no level numbers, so I could not confirm or refute 11 from the kit files and left the existing claim alone.
